newsitem.title: INDIA: India CRISIL downgrades Saurashtra Cement to BBB.
newsitem.headline: India CRISIL downgrades Saurashtra Cement to BBB.

text.p: India's Credit Rating Information Services of India Ltd (CRISIL) said on Wednesday the 'A' rating assigned to the 581.5 million rupees non convertible portion of 831.9 million rupees partly convertible debenture issue of Saurashtra Cement Ltd (SCL) has been downgraded to 'BBB'.
The revised rating indicates moderate safety regarding timely payment of interest and principal.

It said in a statement that SCL operates a single location - single kiln, dry process cement plant with an annual capacity of 1.2 million tonnes; the capacity having been recently enhanced from 0.9 million tonnes per annum. As this plant is relatively old compared to other plants operating in its natural marketing zone, to improve its operational competitiveness SCL is currently implementing a modernisation programme.

The commissioning of new cement capacities in SCL's marketing zone has resulted in an oversupply situation and consequently a decline in realisations during 1996/97. In addition, the reduced level of sales tax benefits available for 1996/97 vis-a-vis 1995/96, is likely to adversely affect SCL's financial performance during 1996/97. The financial risk of the company is likely to remain high, given the current depressed market conditions, CRISIL said.
